Inductive typ : Set :=
| typ_top : typ

| typ_sel : avar -> typ

| typ_bnd :  typ -> typ -> typ.

Inductive lc_avar_at : nat -> avar -> Prop :=
  | lc_ab : forall {n m}, n < m -> lc_avar_at m (avar_b n)
  | lc_af : forall {n x}, lc_avar_at n (avar_f x).

Global Instance LcAvar : LC avar := { lc_at := lc_avar_at }.

Inductive lc_typ_at : nat -> typ -> Prop :=
  | lc_typ_top : forall {n}, lc_typ_at n typ_top
  | lc_typ_bot : forall {n}, lc_typ_at n typ_bot
  | lc_typ_sel : forall {n v}, lc_at n v -> lc_typ_at n (typ_sel v)
  | lc_typ_all : forall {n T U}, lc_typ_at n T -> lc_typ_at (S n) U ->
                            lc_typ_at n (typ_all T U)
  | lc_typ_bnd : forall {n S U}, lc_typ_at n S -> lc_typ_at n U ->
                            lc_typ_at n (typ_bnd S U).

Global Instance LcTyp : LC typ := { lc_at := lc_typ_at }.

Definition open_rec_avar (k : nat) (u : var) (a : avar) : avar :=
    match a with
    | avar_b i => if k == i then avar_f u else avar_b i
    | avar_f x => avar_f x
    end.

Fixpoint open_rec_typ (k : nat) (u : var) (T : typ) : typ :=
    match T with
    | typ_top => typ_top
    | typ_bot => typ_bot
    | typ_sel x => typ_sel $ open_rec_avar k u x
    | typ_all T U => typ_all (open_rec_typ k u T) $ open_rec_typ (S k) u U
    | typ_bnd T U => typ_bnd (open_rec_typ k u T) $ open_rec_typ k u U
    end.

Global Instance OpenAvar : CanOpen avar := { open_rec := open_rec_avar }.

Global Instance OpenTyp : CanOpen typ := { open_rec := open_rec_typ }.

Definition fv_avar (v : avar) : vars :=
    match v with
    | avar_b _ => {}
    | avar_f x => {{ x }}
    end.

Fixpoint fv_typ (T : typ) : vars :=
    match T with
    | typ_top | typ_bot => {}
    | typ_sel x => fv_avar x
    | typ_all T1 T2 | typ_bnd T1 T2 => fv_typ T1 \u fv_typ T2
    end.

Global Instance FvAvar : HasFv avar := { fv := fv_avar }.

Global Instance FvTyp : HasFv typ := { fv := fv_typ }.

Global Instance FvEnv : HasFv env := { fv := fun e => dom e `union` fv_values fv e }.

| avar_b : nat -> avar
| avar_f : var -> avar.

Definition fv_values {T : Type} (f : T -> atoms)
           (l : list (atom * T)) : atoms :=
  fold_right (fun (b : (atom * T)) a =>
                a \u let (_, t) := b in f t) {} l.

Local Lemma sk_dom_fv : forall (G : env), dom G [<=] fv G.
Proof.
  intros. change (dom G [<=] dom G `union` fv_values fv G). fsetdec.
Qed.

Local Lemma sk_fv_env_incl : forall (E G : env),
    incl E G -> fv E [<=] fv G.
Proof.
  assert (entry : forall x T (G : env), In (x,T) G ->
      singleton x `union` fv T [<=] fv G).
  { intros x T G. induction G as [|[y V] G IH]; simpl In; intros H.
    - contradiction.
    - pose proof (sk_fv_env_cons y V G).
      destruct H as [H | H].
      + inversion H; subst. fsetdec.
      + specialize (IH H). fsetdec. }
  induction E as [|[x T] E IH]; intros G H.
  - change (empty `union` empty [<=] fv G). fsetdec.
  - assert (tail : incl E G) by (intros b Hb; apply H; now right).
    pose proof (IH G tail).
    pose proof (entry x T G (H (x,T) (or_introl eq_refl))).
    pose proof (sk_fv_env_cons x T E). fsetdec.
Qed.

    incl E G -> incl (x ~ T ++ E) (x ~ T ++ G).

  intros x T E G H b [<- | Hb].
  - now left.
  - right. now apply H.
Qed.

Proof.
  intros G H. induction H.
  - constructor.
  - apply uniq_push; auto. pose proof (sk_dom_fv G). fsetdec.

  change (lc_typ_at 0 (typ_all A B)) in Hlc. inversion Hlc; subst.
  split; [fsetdec | assumption].

    fv (open_rec k x T) [<=] singleton x `union` fv T.

    change (fv_typ (open_rec_typ k x _) [<=] singleton x `union` fv_typ _);
    simpl.
  - fsetdec.
  - fsetdec.

    change (fv_typ (open_rec_typ (S k) x B) [<=] _) in IHB.
    fsetdec.
  - specialize (IHA k x). specialize (IHB k x).
    change (fv_typ (open_rec_typ k x A) [<=] _) in IHA.
    change (fv_typ (open_rec_typ k x B) [<=] _) in IHB.
    fsetdec.

  induction T as [| |[i|y]|A IHA B IHB|A IHA B IHB]; intros k x H;
    inversion H; subst; simpl.
  - constructor.
  - constructor.
  - unfold open_rec_avar. destruct (k == i) as [<- | Hneq];
      constructor; [constructor |].
    match goal with
    | H : lc_at _ (avar_b _) |- _ => inversion H; subst
    end.
    constructor. now apply Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne.
  - repeat constructor.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.

Local Lemma sk_scoped_all_body : forall G A B x,

    sk_scoped (x ~ A ++ G) (open x B).

  change (fv A `union` fv B [<=] dom G) in Hfv.
  change (lc_typ_at 0 (typ_all A B)) in Hlc. inversion Hlc; subst.
  split.
  - pose proof (sk_fv_open B 0 x).
    pose proof (dom_cons x A G).
    change (fv (open x B) [<=] dom ((x,A) :: G)). fsetdec.
  - apply sk_lc_open. assumption.
Qed.

Local Lemma sk_scoped_top : forall G, sk_scoped G typ_top.
Proof.
  intros. split; [change (empty [<=] dom G); fsetdec | constructor].
Qed.

Local Lemma sk_scoped_bnd_intro : forall G A B,
    sk_scoped G A -> sk_scoped G B -> sk_scoped G (typ_bnd A B).
Proof.
  intros G A B [HA HAlc] [HB HBlc]. split.
  - change (fv A `union` fv B [<=] dom G). fsetdec.
  - constructor; assumption.
Qed.

Local Lemma sk_scoped_lookup : forall G x,
    sk_scoped G (typ_sel (avar_f x)) -> exists T, binds x T G.
Proof.
  intros G x [Hfv _]. change (singleton x [<=] dom G) in Hfv.
  assert (Hin : x `in` dom G) by fsetdec.
  clear Hfv. induction G as [|[y T] G IH].
  - simpl in Hin. fsetdec.
  - pose proof (dom_cons y T G).
    destruct (x == y) as [-> | Hneq].
    + exists T. now left.
    + assert (x `in` dom G) by fsetdec.
      destruct (IH H0) as [U HU]. exists U. now right.
Qed.
